prayerExcerpt.en-US: Renouncing our life for the sake of Christ in this world, may we find it in heaven.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Doar a vida por Cristo neste mundo, para que possamos encontrá-la no céu.

meta.face: A tall, spare man of about fifty with a pale complexion and a long, narrow, well-formed face — a high forehead, a long, fine nose with a gently arched bridge, bright, lively dark eyes under dark, straight brows, lean cheeks with a faint colour high on the cheekbones, a firm, narrow chin and a finely shaped, closed mouth; clean-shaven; dark-brown hair, just touched with grey at the temples, cut short around the tonsure beneath the mitre; a steady, resolute, serene gaze straight ahead.
meta.basis: William FitzStephen, his clerk and biographer, describes him as unusually tall and slender, pale, dark-haired, with a long nose and well-formed features; the card follows that. The clean-shaven face follows the twelfth-century British Library miniature (Cotton MS Claudius B II), and the vestments are an archbishop's with the pallium.
